summary: The artifact compiles and uses Playwright API correctly with proper usage of async/await. The test case ID is preserved in the test title. However, the selector '[data-test="product-1"]' might be too specific or guessed and could cause fragility if the element changes. The URL assertion /product/ is weak and does not verify the correctness of the product detail page in depth. No reusability constructs or test data handling is present. Overall, the code passes but has room for improvement in selector robustness and assertion strength.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' seems very specific and might be fragile to UI changes.
issues.recommendation: Consider using more resilient selectors or a test data setup to make selectors stable.

issues.description: The URL assertion only checks that the URL contains '/product/', which is too generic to ensure the specific product detail page opened.
issues.recommendation: Enhance the assertion by checking for unique page elements or URL parameters that identify the product.

issues.description: No reuse of baseURL or selectors across tests or via fixtures or constants.
issues.recommendation: Consider defining selectors and URLs in a constants file or fixtures to improve maintainability.

recommendations: Improve selector robustness by avoiding overly specific data-test attributes if possible.
Enhance URL or page content assertions to better confirm navigation to the correct product detail page.
Refactor to use reusable constants or fixtures for base URLs and selectors for better maintainability.
